annotations.title: Trace where money came from or went

description: Follow money between addresses. direction in: who sent funds to this address, hop by hop back, plus who first funded it. out: where its funds went, hop by hop forward. both: its largest counterparties either way. Exchanges and protocols end a path. Returns the 15 largest flows. Example: { address: "0x...", direction: "in", depth: 2 }.

address.description: A Sui address (0x...), a SuiNS name like example.sui, or @example.

coin.description: Only this coin (coin type or symbol).

direction.description: in (sources), out (destinations) or both (top counterparties). Default in.

minUsd.description: Skip flows smaller than this many USD. Default 10.

name: trace_funds
title: Trace where money came from or went
